Possibly yes. Leafy Plus members get a **90-day** Plant Care Guarantee, so a plant that's 60 days from delivery is still inside the window, provided you ordered it while your membership was active.

If it qualifies (losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse), we send **one** free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock. To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least **two photos** (whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back.

Note that repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, pests introduced after delivery, or deliberate neglect aren't covered. If you'd like help figuring out what's going wrong in the meantime, a Plant Care Specialist can give free advice by chat or email.
